one_month_reasoning: The Q3 2026 report is not yet scheduled but calendars and last year's cadence (Nov 3, 2025) put it on ~Nov 3, after the window's effective close (Nov 1 is a Sunday, so the mark is the Fri Oct 30 close). In-window items: (1) ASPEED's September monthly sales (~Oct 6-10): after a supply-constrained H1 ASPEED says substrate/test capacity has been added and H2 will be 'significantly better', so another strong print is the expectation and mostly priced; a miss would hit the AI-server control-plane group. (2) The first AMI lock-up tranche, 25% of the 4,741,352 issued shares = ~1.19M shares (~0.8% of shares out), tradable from Mon Oct 26, plus THL's block-trade rights: a small supply overhang right before earnings. (3) OCP Global Summit mid-October and hyperscaler/AI-semi earnings late October (capex commentary). (4) Pre-earnings positioning after a sharp rebound from ~$105-111 lows to $134 (reversal risk) versus a guided ~+65% FPGA quarter. Net: roughly symmetric, centred ~$134.3, monthly sigma ~16.5% (slightly under 61%/3.5 because no earnings print is in the window), tails fattened slightly; the lock-up shaves ~0.5 pt off the at-the-money probability versus round 1.

fair_value.method: Blend of forward P/E (2028E non-GAAP EPS $3.65 x 39x = $142, weight 0.65) and EV/sales (2028E revenue $1.60B x 12x less ~$0.5B net debt over 146M diluted shares = $130, weight 0.35), giving ~$138 a year out. The round-1 street-target leg is dropped as circular.

bear.story: Server control-plane catch-up fades (ASPEED's H2 2026 jump was partly substrate catch-up) and distributors, 95% of revenue with two holding 88% of receivables, destock as in 2024 when revenue fell ~30%; 2027 FPGA flat to down at ~$0.85-0.95B, EPS ~$2.5 and the multiple compresses to ~30x 2028E ~$2.75.

base.story: FPGA grows ~26% in 2027 on server attach and AST2700-generation platforms, AMI ~+25%, 2027 EPS ~$3.00 and 2028E ~$3.65; the multiple de-rates to high-30s, so the stock tracks earnings less de-rating.

bull.story: ASPEED-style visibility into 2028 holds, FPGA grows ~45% to ~$1.2B, AMI cross-sell works, 2028 EPS reaches ~$4.3 and the market keeps ~50x.

thesis_break_reason: ~$87 is ~29x my corrected 2027E EPS of ~$3.00 and ~20% below the Aug-Sep 2026 lows (~$104-111). Trading there would most likely mean a Q3/Q4 guide-down showing that the '2027 pretty much booked' visibility was distributor stocking (95% of revenue via distributors), that ASPEED-type server control-plane demand rolled over once supply caught up (watch ASPEED monthly sales turning negative m/m for several months), or AMI customer attrition, rather than ordinary ~55-60% volatility.

reasoning: Round 2 corrections from the supervisor: my 2027E EPS used a 12% tax rate and $55M interest against a 4-6% non-GAAP tax guide and ~$45M interest; corrected it is ~$3.0 (I keep it ~$0.2 below the $3.21 consensus because I trim 2027 FPGA growth for supply catch-up). The 20% weight on the $164.5 street target was circular and is dropped. Net debt at the horizon is ~$0.5B, not $0.6B. The $1.2B exit rate, '2027 pretty much booked' and $3B-by-2030 are single oral call statements; I no longer lean on $3B for 2028. Alternative-lane follow-up on ASPEED, which sits beside Lattice control FPGAs on server boards: August sales NT$1.6B (+118% y/y), YTD +74%; management says H1 was capped by substrate and test shortages, now eased, H2 will be significantly better, order visibility extends into 2028, and order volumes doubled from late 2025 to Jan 2026. I read that as strong underlying demand with ~5-10 points of catch-up flattering H2 2026, so 2027 FPGA growth of ~+26% (range +8% to +45%). Form 144 insider sales were small; StockTwits and Glassdoor signals are discounted as unverifiable (supervisor agreed). Valuation: P/E $142 (0.65) and EV/sales $130 (0.35) give ~$138, versus $134 spot. The fair value fell from $145 only because the circular leg went; the tax fix raised the P/E leg. Distribution: lognormal with a ~$138 median and ~52% sigma, left tail fattened for distributor-destock risk (2024 precedent of ~-30% revenue). The scenario mix (25% $82 / 50% $143 / 25% $215) has a mean of ~$146, consistent with a right-skewed lognormal. The ladder is essentially unchanged from round 1 because the EPS correction (+) and the dropped target leg (-) offset. I disagree mildly with the supervisor's $3.05-3.20 EPS: I keep $3.00 for the catch-up reason. Research limits: X and Reddit not reachable; ASPEED's September sales not yet published.
